samples.question: What were Apple's iPhone and Services revenue numbers in Q3 2024?
samples.reference_answer: In Q3 2024, Apple Inc. reported iPhone net sales of $39,296 million (down 1% year-over-year) and Services revenue of $24,213 million (up 14% to an all-time record). Total net sales were $85,777 million with a gross margin of 46.3%.
reference_contexts: Apple Inc. Form 10-Q Q3 2024. Revenue by Product Category: iPhone net sales were $39,296 million (down 1%). Services reached an all-time record of $24,213 million (up 14%). Total net sales were $85,777 million with gross margin of 46.3%.

provenance.notes: Verified against Apple Inc. Form 10-Q Statements of Operations for the quarterly period ended June 29, 2024
